The change remains correct and complete. The executed-page test is non-vacuous: its interior-refusal case distinguishes the prior array-index implementation, its leading-refusal case rejects partial gap-closing fixes, and its all-accepted control catches zero-based or collapsed numbering. Documentation matches the behavior. This display-only adjustment preserves the URL refusal and does not weaken trust-plane controls, permissions, token handling, or injection defenses. Round 2 has the same clean result as the approved prior round.
